sql: SELECT strftime(g.ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day_utc, round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.firmware_version = '1.1.0' THEN d.device_id END) / count(DISTINCT d.device_id), 2) AS pct_on_1_1_0 FROM generate_series(TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 23:59:59', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-07 23:59:59', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS g(ts) JOIN marts.dim_device d ON d.valid_from <= g.ts AND g.ts < d.valid_to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(g.ts, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day_utc, round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.firmware_version = '1.1.0' THEN d.device_id END) / count(DISTINCT d.device_id), 2) AS pct_on_1_1_0 FROM generate_series(TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 23:59:59', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-07 23:59:59', INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS g(ts) JOIN marts.dim_device d ON d.valid_from <= g.ts AND g.ts < d.valid_to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
